questions.question: In the context of this patient's weight (104 kg), why was the 0.3 mg epinephrine auto-injector insufficiently effective initially, and what is the recommended standard dosing for an adult over 50 kg?

What clinical features in this patient's history and physical exam support a differential diagnosis of systemic mastocytosis rather than standard IgE-mediated anaphylaxis?
